trial_court: Court of Additional District Judge, Parasia, District Chhindwara (RCSHM/8/2023)
case_name: Smt. Jasmeen Kaur Vig vs Manpreet Singh Vig
facts_of_case: The applicant/wife seeks transfer of the case filed by the respondent/husband under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act from the Court of Additional District Judge, Parasia to the Family Court at Indore. The applicant/wife was subjected to cruelty and various litigation is pending at Indore.

legal_principles.principle: The factum of inconvenience as well as hardship to the applicant/wife cannot be ruled out.
legal_principles.held: Taking into the consideration the grounds as narrated in Paragraphs 9 and 10 of the application under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Court at Parasia as well as the grounds as incorporated by the applicant/wife in the present application,

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the concerned Court to sift the evidence and consider the stand of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: The said stand of the respondent is required to be considered by the concerned Court after sifting the evidence, which is to be adduced by the parties.

outcome.final_order: Case No. RCSHM/8/2023 be transferred from the Court of Additional District Judge, Parasia, District Chhindwara to the Family Court at Indore.
